Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: nine transparent sports lesson game props and actions. One exact square 3×3 production sprite atlas. Equal square cells, strict row-major order, each subject centered in its own cell with at least 13% clear margin on every edge. All nine cells must be occupied and distinct, with no objects crossing cell boundaries. Genuinely transparent alpha background throughout the entire sheet, including margins, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no colored cards, no ground shadow or background panel. Keep each object fully visible and legible at 45 px. Original educational art for age 6: matte gouache on fine paper grain, clean paper-cut silhouettes, warm cream and deep pine green with restrained apricot and persimmon. Large readable forms, charming but calm. No words, letters, numerals, logos, UI, watermarks, decorative scenery, or floating scraps. No existing characters or textbook imagery.
Row 1 left to right: (1) one white framed soccer goal with clear net, front three-quarter view, no ball; (2) one basketball hoop with orange rim, full white net, simple backboard and upright post, no ball; (3) one teal table tennis table viewed front three-quarter, clear thin net across its center, four legs, no people or paddles.
Row 2 left to right: (4) one spherical pale aqua glass marble for a launch game with orange-gold reflected highlight, simple clean large sphere, no other object; (5) exactly two six-year-old children playing table tennis opposite each other at the two ends of one clearly visible teal table with a net. One red paddle in each child's hand and one tiny white ball over the net, complete figures, distinct coral and light-blue sports shirts, no bystanders; (6) a single mint-green low school equipment cart, pale rubber wheels, clear empty tray, three-quarter view, no action lines.
Row 3 left to right: (7) the same single mint-green low school equipment cart at the same angle, pale rubber wheels, with two very short motion marks by the rear wheel; (8) one gold-orange star-shaped sports reward sticker with a thin cream trim and very simple face-free star silhouette; (9) one bold upright golden-yellow handheld reporter microphone with a navy blue mesh grille, visually recognizable, no stand or cord.
